Remark
Source: cheeger-gromov-taylor:page-0009 1. Remark after Theorem 1.4\group section-1

The estimate for $i(x_j)$ in Theorem 31 can be sharpened when $\rho _j$ is sufficiently large, as in Theorem thm:injectivity-radius-relative-volume(ii). For compact $M^n$, known injectivity radius bounds may be substituted.

Theorem 31 extends to $\partial M^n\ne \emptyset $ using a suitable generalization of Proposition prop:refined-injectivity-angle-lower-estimates.
